changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwWaseelEligibilityRequest AS SELECT w.id, w.patient_id, w.encounter_id, w.patient_insurance_id, w.provider_id, w.destination_id, w.service_date, w.benefits, w.discovery, w.validation, w.transfer, w.emergency, w.api_status, w.status_code, w.message, w.eligibility_response_id, w.eligibility_response_url, w.waseel_request_id, w.request_status, w.requested_at, w.responded_at, w.request_json, w.response_json, w.created_by, w.created_date, w.last_modified_by, w.last_modified_date FROM public.waseel_eligibility_request w;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwWaseelEligibilityRequest TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwWaseelEligibilityRequest FROM report_user;
